text:
Ari (Marketing): Draft is in the doc — quick sanity pass? Need hero claim, webinar demo slot, and inbound routing by EOD. https://docs.google.com/d/1xLaunchDraft

Priya (Content): On it. I'll skim headline + intro. Can we avoid words like 'revolutionary'? keep it measurable. :thinking_face:

Sam (Growth): For benchmark line — what exact metric are we using? '2x cost savings' reads strong. Is that median or best-case? Need backup for landing page CTA.

Ari (Marketing): Good call. Bench is median across 3 customers on our dedicated plan vs host fallback. I put more detail in appendix, but landing hero currently says: "Up to 2x lower inference cost at scale"

Elena (Legal): Please change to "up to 2x lower inference cost" and avoid implying guaranteed results. Also need links to the benchmark methodology in the post and a short footnote.

Priya (Content): I'll update the hero to "Up to 2x lower inference cost at scale" and add a parenthetical link to the appendix. Drafting the footnote now.

Lina (Events): Webinar/demo logistics: we have one preferred demo slot on June 10 @ 10am PT (30 min). Can we confirm speaker? @Ari who will demo — product or solutions? Also need CTA mapping for registrants -> HubSpot list.

Ari (Marketing): Planning to have Sam demo core routing + a quick Q&A. Sam, you good for June 10?

Sam (Growth): Yep, can do. Will keep demo to 12 minutes and reserve 15 for Q&A. Need slides + a runbook. Lina, please send calendar invite. calendar-bot: Event created — "Launch Webinar: Redwood Optimize" June 10 10:00 PT. :calendar:

Lina (Events): Got it, invite sent to required panelists. Registration cap at 500, but we can up it if demand spikes.

Mark (Ops): For inbound lead routing / HubSpot mapping: use source=blog, campaign=optimize-launch-2026. Proposed tags: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=optimize-launch-2026, lead_stage=marketing_webinar. Map to list ID 987654.

Ari (Marketing): Thanks Mark. Adding UTM snippet into the doc so copy team can bake links.

Priya (Content): Draft CTAs updated. Suggest primary CTA -> "Register for demo" and secondary -> "Request a dedicated trial". Also added short variant for social cards.

Ari (Marketing): Including final UTM example for ops to copy:```https://redwood.com/optimize?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize-launch-2026&utm_content=cta-register```

Mark (Ops): Perfect — I'll add tracking in HubSpot and set up an automation to tag registrants with "optimize_launch_2026" and routing rules to Sales queue A. Also please ensure the registration form asks: company size, primary use-case, and region.

Elena (Legal): Note on customer quotes: any customer attribution must have written approval. Priya, please add a yellow highlight to quotes that still need signoff.

Priya (Content): Will do. I flagged two quotes (lines 132-137) that need approvals from customers A and B. Added an email template for outreach in the doc.

Sam (Growth): Small copy suggestion for hero line: "Up to 2x lower inference cost at production scale" — adds clarity. What do you think?

Ari (Marketing): I like that. Priya can you swap 'at scale' -> 'at production scale' across assets?

Priya (Content): Done. Replaced across hero, social snippets, and meta description.

Lina (Events): Quick ops note: please attach the slide deck here once final so I can pin in the registration confirmation email. Also need the 1-line speaker bio for Sam.

Sam (Growth): Bio: "Sam Patel, Head of Growth at Redwood Inference — previously led ML infra at ScaleAI, focuses on inference economics." Short enough?

Lina (Events): Perfect, adding to registration page.

Ari (Marketing): Final checklist before publish: (1) Legal tweak done — Elena? (2) Quotes approved or flagged — Priya? (3) HubSpot mapping live — Mark? (4) Deck & speaker bio attached — Lina? (5) Publish time — propose June 8 9am PT.

Elena (Legal): (1) Done. Wording adjusted in doc and footnote added.

Priya (Content): (2) Quotes: 1 approved, 2 pending — outreach sent. Highlighted pending ones.

Mark (Ops): (3) Mapping scheduled. I'll confirm when automation is live (ETA: tomorrow morning).

Lina (Events): (4) Deck uploaded to the doc, speaker bio in registration page.

Ari (Marketing): (5) June 8 9am PT publish. If all green, we'll proceed. Please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm.

Sam (Growth): :thumbsup:

Priya (Content): :thumbsup:

Mark (Ops): :thumbsup: I'll ping when HubSpot automation is live.

Elena (Legal): :thumbsup: small note — remove superlatives from social variants.

Lina (Events): :thumbsup: — will open demo rehearsal slot on June 8 2pm PT for panel run-through.

Ari (Marketing): Thanks everyone — I'll merge changes and schedule the publish. If quotes don't arrive, we'll swap with anonymized snippets.

calendar-bot: Reminder set — Rehearsal June 8 14:00 PT.

Mark (Ops): HubSpot automation live. Confirmed routing to Sales queue A and list ID 987654. Changed last_message_ts to mark end of thread."
